title: Lil Armstrong's death at the Pacific Plaza tribute
summary: Lil Armstrong, brought from Idlewild for a tribute to Louis, collapsed playing St. Louis Blues while the event was being filmed.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Keeled over, right, right. Well, that was what happened with Lil Armstrong, you remember?
Oh, that's right, she was working with you.
With me at the -- what's its name, and I felt so bad.
At -- was it at the First National Bank Plaza?
No, at the Pacific Plaza.
The Pacific Plaza?
Right, around -- right under the Picasso.
And that was a tribute to Louis Armstrong.

Yeah. See, what had happened was, see, like the kids, when they get ready to go back to school and they were putting on this program. So I said, now, New York has done this thing for Louis Armstrong, and New Orleans has done one, so has the city of Chicago. So Louis said okay, and this was a tribute to him. And she was up in that place, up in Idlewild, Michigan. And I called her up there, and asked her if -- she just had to be here. She came, and she was playing.
'St. Louis Blues.'
'St. Louis Blues,' and just fell right over. Just the same thing.
To me, that's a beautiful death.
Oh, it was beautiful. She was doing the thing that she --
It's just over like that, and you're playing --
You're doing what you wanted to do.
Playing the blues.
Right, and she was just such a happy person.
Playing the blues at High Noon.
Yeah.
In the center of Chicago --
Right, right, and the cameras and
everything was on her, because -- they filmed that. Because they was filming the whole thing, and it just -- it happened.
